issues.on_page: Statement of Activities general receipts: Health Insurance Settlements 5,581 + Miscellaneous 62,817 = 68,398
issues.issue: The p4 Miscellaneous line is broken down on p2: 5,581 is settlements (Opioid Settlement Fund 5,580 on p13/p15), which could be reimbursements/refunds rather than other. The extractor did not split it; that is defensible because p2 is a different statement, but the user may want the 5,581 recategorized. Same for detail[119] (Nonmajor Miscellaneous 5,580).
This is the Inheritance Tax Fund's only receipt line, so it is almost certainly inheritance tax; it is kept as taxes (unlabeled) with review. Defensible, but inheritance tax could be used here.

682,227 of unbudgeted General Fund spending labelled 'Inherit Tax' sits under Miscellaneous, with no function category. It is about 10% of governmental spending and its purpose is not stated (it is not a transfer: no fund shows a matching transfer in). This also drives disbursements[5] (Miscellaneous 731,345, other). It needs a person to look at it; decision_needed[] is absent.
